SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) boats, SUM(yt) total_yt, SUM(anglers) total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) yt_per_angler 
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls 
ORDER BY fish_date_doy ASC, cls ASC
SELECT DISTINCT cls FROM schedule WHERE fish_date_season = 6 ORDER BY cls
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_season FROM trips ORDER BY fish_date_season
SELECT fish_date_season, string_agg(DISTINCT cls, ',') classes FROM trips GROUP BY fish_date_season ORDER BY fish_date_season

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) boats, SUM(yt) total_yt, SUM(anglers) total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) yt_per_angler 
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy > 25
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls 
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls, 
  COUNT(*) boats, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, 
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season IN (1,2,3,4,5) AND cls IN ('day_1_5', 'multi_day')
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_season, cls, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT ts_doy, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c)::numeric, 1) temp_c, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c) * 9/5 + 32, 1) temp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 25
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10
